question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

HINDER
solution:
The correct answer is '**help**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the words and an example.
 
• **Hinder**: make it difficult for someone to do something or for something to happen.
 
• Meaning of Antonyms:
 
 
• **help**: making it easier for someone to do something by offering one's services or resources
 
• **heal**: to make or become well again, especially after a cut or other injury.
 
• **hope**: a feeling of expectation and desire for a particular thing to happen
 
• **hire**: employ someone for wages
 
 

Hence, the correct **antonym **for **hinder **is **help**.

 
• **Example**:* I offered to **help __**her in moving out but she had too much pride to accept it*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__**

__
 
• Hinder: बाधा ड़ालना
 
• विलोम शब्द
 
 
• **help**: सहारा देना
 
• **heal**: ठीक होना
 
• **hope**: आशा
 
• **hire**: मजदूरी पर रखना
 
 
 
• **Hinder **का विलोम शब्द **help **है
 
• **Example**: *she was certain that no one would **help __**her.*
